title: One inspection crew
heading: Whiteboard: One Inspection Crew, Release Weeks and Blocked Weeks
cases: a schedule with the jobs apart is allowed, and one with two jobs in the same week refused
a job that runs through a blocked period is refused
a job that ends after its deadline is refused
a job may start in the week after the previous job's last week
a job whose end equals its deadline is allowed
a job that starts before its deadline but ends after it is refused
a job working only the last week of a blocked period is refused
